processDeviation.rationale: The G1 seam, qualification Workers, MCP supervisor, and tests existed before this plan was frozen. Every earlier green test is discovery evidence only. No earlier invocation, log, cache, or result may satisfy a row below; the candidate requires a clean run after root resolves and freezes every binding.

claimBoundary.candidateClaim: For the frozen legacy/current corpus and explicitly listed boundary/failure matrix only, the test-only SemanticProgram-to-Manifold plan path is observationally equivalent to the frozen direct evaluator and remains isolated from production routing.
claimBoundary.successMeaning: All rows pass all clean runs on every listed environment within the frozen budgets, with exactly the expected success or typed refusal and with no skipped or reused work unit.

included.statement: All 65 cases in the frozen manifold-plan oracle, including success, typed error, preview reduction, warnings, identities, provenance, mesh/scene digests, and metrics.
included.enforcement: Independent oracle capture and field-class comparator; every case is one work unit and no case may be filtered or retried.

included.statement: The comparator must detect each of the 18 predeclared one-field or one-invariant mutations without consulting candidate implementation code.
included.enforcement: Each mutation is injected separately into a cloned frozen outcome and must produce the named field-class/path mismatch.

included.statement: Cooperative cancellation, source limit refusal, preview/full policy, and backend cleanup failure remain distinct bounded terminal outcomes.
included.enforcement: Four named terminal work units run in fresh sessions with exact error class/code and no partial success publication.

included.statement: entityId, instanceId, and operationId each publish at 256 UTF-16 code units and refuse at 257 before success publication across Node Worker, actual Vite browser Worker, and MCP child boundaries.
included.enforcement: Six independently controlled values are exercised on every listed transport; a 257 failure must be followed by a successful request in a fresh realm.

included.statement: The qualification lane and Worker URL are transformed and executed by actual Vite in Playwright-managed Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, not a Node WebWorker shim.
included.enforcement: Each browser has its own blocking matrix row and frozen binary digest; success requires the emitted module Worker, started handshake, bounded 257 refusal, deadline termination request, and fresh-epoch recovery.

included.statement: The MCP qualification child has a separate startup handshake/deadline, correlated terminal protocol, bounded cancellation, terminate-and-join hard kill, stdout/stderr containment, join quarantine, and fresh-epoch recovery.
included.enforcement: The supervisor suite runs on Ubuntu Node 20/22, macOS Node 20, and Windows Node 20; all 13 predeclared scenarios pass without retry.

included.statement: Over actual newline-delimited MCP stdio with the real in-memory DuckDB store, a confirmed non-cooperative shadow cannot block ping or tools/list, emits exactly one terminal, writes no late record, and does not prevent the next direct request.
included.enforcement: The child writes a private stdout sentinel and enters a non-cooperative loop before probes; only primary direct builds may appear in history and every server stdout line must remain valid JSON-RPC.

included.statement: Qualification IPC, deadlines, responsiveness, peak RSS, retained-memory deltas, and post-warmup RSS slopes stay within the exact budgets below.
included.enforcement: Serial clean-process resource probes use fixed cycle counts, sample points, regression method, and per-run pass criteria; median-only acceptance is forbidden.

included.statement: Manifold imports remain confined to the narrow kernel adapter and qualification code does not enter the production registry or alter direct-v5 routing.
included.enforcement: A source dependency audit and direct-route manifest assertion run from the frozen candidate bundle.

excluded.statement: Production provider registration, product routing, feature flags, UI exposure, rollout, or default behavior changes.
excluded.reason: G1 qualifies a test-only neutral seam; activation belongs to a separately approved later gate.
excluded.enforcement: No production registry/createServer import from the supervisor except explicit test injection; any observed product route change rejects this candidate.

excluded.statement: B-rep topology, NURBS evaluation, intersections, trimming, Boolean certification, healing, STEP, or IGES.
excluded.reason: These capabilities belong to G2 and later plans.
excluded.enforcement: No capability claim or result from this plan may be attached to a brep-1 manifest.

excluded.statement: New grammar or legacy/current behavior outside the frozen oracle and named boundary sources.
excluded.reason: G1 is a seam-equivalence gate, not a language-conformance expansion.
excluded.enforcement: Unexpected source cases are discovery-only and require a new plan version before becoming evidence.

excluded.statement: Geometry protocol v6, GeometrySceneV2, renderer migration, selection, export leases, or topology snapshots.
excluded.reason: Those are G4a and later capabilities.
excluded.enforcement: Only the frozen legacy LME1/LSE1 and direct-v5 observable boundary are compared.

excluded.statement: Process-level OOM, native crash, host termination, hostile code sandboxing, or operating-system resource exhaustion.
excluded.reason: Worker hard-kill covers non-cooperative JavaScript execution but shares the parent process failure domain.
excluded.enforcement: No evidence row or approval may reinterpret Worker termination as process isolation.

excluded.statement: Branded Chrome/Safari, mobile browsers, non-Playwright browser builds, Linux distributions other than Ubuntu 24.04, or architectures other than those listed.
excluded.reason: The target matrix is finite and hash-bound.
excluded.enforcement: Results from unlisted environments are supplemental discovery evidence only.

excluded.statement: An assertion that collaborating review agents constitute organizationally independent approval.
excluded.reason: They are role-separated within the same agent system and cannot supply the missing organizational review.
excluded.enforcement: The independent reviewer and release authority remain explicitly pending and block qualification.

cleanRunDefinition: Start from the exact frozen candidate and harness bundle digests with a clean working tree; generated result files are outside both bundles.
Delete build outputs, Vite caches, test caches, DuckDB files, and prior qualification results before dependency installation.
Install exactly package-lock.json with npm ci and verify the frozen lockfile, Node, and browser binary SHA-256 values before importing candidate code.
Use a fresh operating-system job and fresh process for each clean run; no warm Worker, Manifold instance, browser context, database, or module cache crosses clean-run boundaries.
Record OS image, architecture, runtime/browser digests, seed, start/end timestamps, command, exit status, per-unit count, resource samples, and stdout/stderr artifact digests.
Do not retry a failed work unit, filter a case, adjust a timeout/budget, or substitute a browser build inside the same candidate run.
executionProtocol.concurrencyPolicy: one qualification row per fresh process; memory rows serial; no shared worker realm between units
executionProtocol.admissionRule: all bindings frozen, no unresolved rows that block execution, and execution authorization recorded
executionProtocol.passRule: every matrix row passes every required clean run within frozen budgets; zero false-complete; no skipped unit; no result reuse

resetPolicy.unitFailure: reject-candidate; no rerun-to-green within the same candidate run
resetPolicy.infrastructureFailure: invalidate the entire clean run; one documented restart allowed only after proving candidate code did not execute
resetPolicy.mutationsAfterFreeze: any scoped source, oracle, comparator, harness, dependency, seed, threshold, or environment change requires a new plan version and resets all counters

triggers.condition: Any path in a frozen artifact or bundle changes bytes or membership.
Node, browser, operating-system image, package-lock, Vite, TypeScript, serializer, or Manifold dependency identity changes.
Scope, oracle, comparator, mutation, seed, work count, clean-run count, budget, timeout, reset rule, or pass rule changes.
Any planned unit has an unexpected terminal, mismatch, timeout, budget breach, stdout contamination, late persistence, skipped case, or retry.
A host/provisioning failure occurs and logs prove candidate code and browser Worker were never imported or executed.
A failure is labelled infrastructure-related but candidate execution cannot be ruled out.

unresolvedRows.resolution: After all concurrent files settle, root computes and records the schema, package-lock, candidate-bundle, and harness-bundle SHA-256 bindings; any path-list change requires a new plan version.
Provision the exact Node runtimes and record SHA-256 for Ubuntu Node 20/22, macOS Node 20, and Windows Node 20.
Pin the browser harness in package-lock, install Playwright-managed Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, and record each executable SHA-256 plus the shared Vite-host Node digest.

Add the isolated scripts/run-browser-qualification.mjs runner, prove it serves the test-only entry through actual Vite, emits the Worker asset, and executes the three exact browser commands before freezing the harness bundle.

Extend controlled test-only Worker fixtures so entityId, instanceId, and operationId are each isolated at 256 and 257 on Node, actual Vite browser, and MCP child boundaries; source-derived coupled lengths are supplemental only.

Implement the browser mode of scripts/run-manifold-g1-memory-qualification.mjs with the exact sampling points, process-tree RSS collection, regression formula, job counts, and per-run failure rules, then freeze it in the harness bundle. The existing MCP 4+24-job probe remains discovery-only until the clean rerun.
Once execution admission is ready, execute all 6270 planned work units in the required clean runs and publish a separate append-only result artifact; no prior green result may be imported.
Assign an organizationally independent reviewer who did not author the candidate, oracle, comparator, or plan, and record a decision against the frozen plan and new result artifact.
A release authority records approve or reject after all evidence and independent review; even approval does not authorize production cutover under this plan.
